product_identity.summary: Acme Notes is a shared note-taking app for small teams. It pairs a fast editor with team spaces and a public API, and sells per seat after a free tier.

jtbds.job: Capture a thought before it is lost
jtbds.why: The home page leads with one-keystroke capture from anywhere.

jtbds.job: Keep a team's notes in one place
jtbds.why: Team spaces and shared folders are the paid tier's headline.

jtbds.job: Find an old note in seconds
jtbds.why: Full-text search across spaces is featured and praised in reviews.

features.name: Quick capture
features.description: Global shortcut opens a capture window from any app.

features.name: Full-text search
features.description: Search across every space, with filters by author and date.

features.name: Public API
features.description: REST API with personal tokens for scripts and integrations.

voc.quote: Capture is instant, which is the whole reason I switched.
